subject: Vendor security questionnaire initiation — CAIQ vs custom form and encryption key handling
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Ramos <ellen.ramos@finpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire initiation — CAIQ vs custom form and encryption key handling

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can kick off the security questionnaire on our side: 

1) Questionnaire type: you mentioned the CAIQ as the preferred baseline but also that your security team sometimes wants a short custom addendum for data residency and key management. Can you confirm whether we should:
   - (A) send the CAIQ + the short Redwood addendum we use for key residency, or
   - (B) start with your custom form (if you already have one) and we’ll prefill what we can?

2) SOC 2: you said SOC 2 is in progress with a June target. Can you share the expected report type (Type I/II) and whether you’ll accept our SOC 2 readiness summary in the meantime?

3) Encryption & keys: simple checkbox here — will you require BYOK (bring-your-own-key) / customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for production workloads, or is platform-managed encryption acceptable for an initial POC? If BYOK, do you have a preferred provider (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, external HSM)?

4) Data residency: confirm whether EU residency is required for any data class in scope or if US-only is fine for the POC.

Next steps we propose: we can attach the CAIQ and our short KMS addendum for review — if you prefer your custom form, please send it and we’ll prefill within 2 business days. I’ve attached the CAIQ request bundle and a one-pager on Redwood’s KMS options to speed review.

Action items for FinPath: pick A or B above and share any custom questionnaire + target SOC 2 milestone.

Happy to sync on a quick 20-min follow-up if you want to walk the team through the questions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinPath_SIG_Request.pdf (SIG/CAIQ bundle stub), redwood-kms-one-pager.pdf (stub)

Thanks Karthik — good recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- We prefer option B: FinPath has a short custom security addendum (3 pages) that covers residency and encryption choices. I'll attach it to this thread by EOD. If you can prefill the sections on hosting and network controls that will speed review.
- SOC 2: we expect to have a Type II report by the end of Q3 (Sept). For procurement, our security team will accept a readiness summary and the SOC 2 Type II target date during the POC period.
- Keys: for production we'll require customer-managed keys (BYOK) in AWS KMS. For POC, platform-managed keys are acceptable; however we need architectural notes on how Redwood isolates tenant keys and key rotation processes.
- Residency: for now, POC can be US-only. If/when we expand to EU users we'll need EU region hosting.

Can you prefill the custom addendum and send back by Tuesday? Also, our security team likes to get the CAIQ for mapping — if you can include both CAIQ and the prefilled addendum that would be ideal.

Ellen
Ellen Ramos
Head of IT & Security
FinPath Analytics

Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire initiation — CAIQ vs custom form and encryption key handling

Thanks for the quick answers, Ellen — helpful. A couple clarifications from our side so your security team has the details they asked for: 

- BYOK architecture (short): Redwood supports customer-managed keys in AWS KMS via a per-tenant CMK in the customer AWS account for dedicated deployments, or via an HSM-backed KMS integration for private on-prem installations. For hosted/Dedicated we also provide envelope encryption with a tenant-specific intermediate key stored in Redwood's KMS; we do not persist unencrypted tenant keys. I attached a 1-pager that diagrams the flows.
- Key rotation & access: rotations can be scheduled by customers; access is strictly auditable and limited to principal identities you configure in your account. We provide audit logs that tie cryptographic operations to request IDs for traceability.
- CAIQ vs custom: we will attach the CAIQ for mapping purposes; once you send your 3-page addendum we'll prefill both and return a single package (CAIQ + addendum) within 48 business hours.

I'll attach the prefill template and the CAIQ bundle to the next reply. If it helps, we can set up a 30-min call tomorrow at 10:00am PT to walk your security engineer through the BYOK flows — Marissa will join for procurement questions.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
